promises.statement: H2 will be better than H1 and we will return to growth in H2 by Q4.
promises.quote: During the outlook, we have just mentioned that H2 will be better than H1, and we will return to growth in H2 by Q4, driven by the Q4 performance

promises.verdict: Target period is H2 FY27 which has not been reported yet.

promises.statement: Solutions and products growth is expected to be 30% plus.
promises.quote: First is faster growth with solution products. We believe this growth, we expect to be 30% on this, even though it's a small part, as we said, initially we start with 20 25%. We'll grow with 30% plus growth rate in these solutions and products
promises.speaker: Kishor Patil, CEO
promises.actual: Solutions and products growth breakdown not reported in financial disclosures
promises.verdict: Data on solutions and products segment revenue growth is not disclosed in reported numbers.

promises.statement: We will be able to hold on to our EBITDA in the immediate future and increase margins in the mid-term.
promises.quote: And we have provide directionally that We'll be able to hold on to our EBITDA in the immediate future. In spite of the headwinds, we'll capitalize on the tailwinds that we have, but more importantly, in the midterm, we want to increase our margins.
promises.speaker: Sachin Tikekar, President and Joint MD
promises.actual: EBITDA margin 15.0% in Jun 2026 and 16.0% in Sep 2026
promises.verdict: Mid-term target period is ongoing; margin currently lower at 15-16%.

promises.statement: We will grow next year higher than this year.
promises.quote: We will for sure grow next year higher than this year. And we believe that we will be in a position to do it.
promises.speaker: Kishor Patil, CEO
promises.actual: YoY growth 8.8% in Jun 2026 and 6.5% in Sep 2026 vs 10.5% in FY26
promises.verdict: FY27 performance is ongoing, currently tracking below FY26 growth rate.

promises.statement: Our profitability will improve from what we have in Q3 in spite of our investments.
promises.quote: our profitability will improve from what we have in Q3 in spite of our investments.
promises.speaker: Kishor Patil, CEO
promises.actual: Net profit increased from Rs 133 crore (Dec 2025) to Rs 163 crore (Mar 2026)
promises.verdict: Absolute profitability improved in Q4 FY26 over Q3 FY26 as promised.

promises.statement: In the last quarter that is Q4, our growth will be higher, it will be the highest quarterly growth in FY26.
promises.quote: we believe that in the last quarter that is Q4, we will improve, our growth will be higher, it will be the highest quarterly growth in FY26.
promises.speaker: Kishor Patil, CEO
promises.actual: QoQ growth was 5.8% in Mar 2026 (Q4) vs 0.7%, 3.2%, 1.8% in Q1-Q3 FY26
promises.verdict: Q4 FY26 recorded the highest quarterly QoQ revenue growth rate of the fiscal year.

promises.statement: Maintain 21% EBITDA margin for the full year despite salary increments.
promises.quote: And we are very confident that what we have talked about, that we will be in a position to maintain 21% EBITDA for the full year.
promises.speaker: Kishor Patil, Co-Founder, CEO, and MD
promises.actual: Full year FY26 EBITDA margin came in at 19.0%
promises.verdict: FY26 EBITDA margin fell short of the 21% full-year target.

promises.statement: Quarter 3 will have a flattish to positive organic constant currency growth.
promises.quote: We believe that in the Quarter 3, we will be in a position to have a flattish to positive organic constant currency growth
promises.speaker: Kishor Patil, Co-Founder, CEO, and MD
promises.actual: Revenue QoQ growth in Dec 2025 was 1.8%
promises.verdict: Dec 2025 (Q3 FY26) posted positive quarterly revenue growth.

promises.statement: Quarter 4 will see meaningful growth coming in.
promises.quote: In terms of Quarter 4, we do believe that there will be a meaningful growth, which will be coming in.
promises.speaker: Kishor Patil, Co-Founder, CEO, and MD
promises.actual: Revenue QoQ growth in Mar 2026 reached 5.8%
promises.verdict: Q4 FY26 delivered strong sequential revenue acceleration.

promises.statement: We believe we can maintain the EBITDA margins at 21% in the foreseeable future.
promises.quote: Right now, I would say, in a foreseeable future, we believe we can maintain the margins at 21%.
promises.speaker: Kishor Patil, CEO and MD
promises.actual: EBITDA margins dropped to 19.0% in Q1/Q2 FY26 and 15.0% in Q1 FY27
promises.verdict: EBITDA margins declined sequentially below 21% throughout FY26 and FY27.

promises.statement: India and China together will be a 3-digit number in terms of revenues in 2 years.
promises.quote: I will not give any specific numbers, but I can tell you that in 2 years, this will be a 3-digit number in terms of revenues, India, China together.
promises.speaker: Kishor Patil, CEO and MD
promises.verdict: Two-year target period is still ongoing.

deliveredSummary: Management achieved Q4 FY26 growth acceleration targets, but missed standing 21% EBITDA margin guidance as operational margins deteriorated to 15-16% in early FY27 while YoY growth decelerated.

divergences.story: Management expresses confidence in growth recovery and expanding profitability mid-term.
divergences.numbers: Revenue growth slowed from 22.7% (Sep 2024) to 6.5% (Sep 2026); EBITDA margin dropped to 16%.
EBITDA margin declined continuously from 21% in FY25 to 19% in FY26 and 16% in Sep 2026.

bull: Delivered 5.8% QoQ revenue growth in Q4 FY26, fulfilling its highest quarterly growth promise.
Cash conversion ratio remains healthy with cumulative CFO to Net Profit of 165%.
Commercial vehicle and off-highway segment grew 27% YoY in Q2 FY27 per management.
bear: EBITDA margin collapsed from 21.0% in Mar 2025 to 16.0% in Sep 2026.
Net profit declined 28.4% YoY in Sep 2026, marking five consecutive quarters of negative YoY profit growth.
Borrowings increased significantly from Rs 345 crore in Mar 2025 to Rs 764 crore in Sep 2026.
business: KPIT Technologies provides global software solutions, embedded software, AI, and digital solutions for next-generation mobility technologies across Europe, USA, Japan, China, Thailand, and India.
